VALUE_ITEMS[0].NAME: Empathy
VALUE_ITEMS[0].DESCRIPTION: We share the feelings and emotions of our participants and treat the emotional state of veterans and children with understanding and respect.
VALUE_ITEMS[1].NAME: Empowerment
VALUE_ITEMS[1].DESCRIPTION: We strive not only to be there for participants but also to directly contribute to their recovery and further personal development.
VALUE_ITEMS[2].NAME: Unity
VALUE_ITEMS[2].DESCRIPTION: We create a community of support, care, and trust, because together we are stronger.
VALUE_ITEMS[3].NAME: Diversity
VALUE_ITEMS[3].DESCRIPTION: We respect and value the unique experience and life path of every person we interact with.
VALUE_ITEMS[4].NAME: Resilience
VALUE_ITEMS[4].DESCRIPTION: We believe in the strength of the human spirit and sincerely strive to support everyone on their path of overcoming difficulties and building resilience.
VALUE_ITEMS[5].NAME: Responsibility
VALUE_ITEMS[5].DESCRIPTION: We take responsibility for our actions and words before participants, partners, and benefactors.
VALUE_ITEMS[6].NAME: Partnership
VALUE_ITEMS[6].DESCRIPTION: We cultivate partnership and the exchange of experience at the local, national, and international levels.
VALUE_ITEMS[7].NAME: Innovation
VALUE_ITEMS[7].DESCRIPTION: We strive for continuous search and implementation of new approaches to therapy and mental health recovery for effective support of our community.
VALUE_ITEMS[8].NAME: Transparency and Honesty
VALUE_ITEMS[8].DESCRIPTION: We adhere to the principles of openness, transparency, and ethics in our activities and beyond.
INTRO_DETAILS.FIRST_LINE: Victory Center is not about terms or numbers.
INTRO_DETAILS.SECOND_LINE: It’s about feelings. Here you stop in the moment,
INTRO_DETAILS.THIRD_LINE: where tension disappears and healing begins.
INTRO_DETAILS.FOURTH_LINE: Through community, nature, and contact with horses you return to your true self. We don’t change people. We help them remember

SUPPORT_DATA[0].DESCRIPTION: Veterans who returned from the frontlines or captivity and strive to restore contact with themselves, their bodies, and their loved ones.
SUPPORT_DATA[1].DESCRIPTION: Volunteers and civilians who feel the need for emotional recovery and want to continue supporting others.
SUPPORT_DATA[2].DESCRIPTION: Children affected by war who have experienced loss, fear, or displacement. Through play therapy, group interaction, and contact with animals, we help restore trust and a sense of safety.

WHAT_WE_DO_DETAILS: We create therapeutic programs that combine interaction with horses, body practices, contact with nature, psychological support, and a supportive community. Each program is adapted to the individual needs of participants.
TEAM_DETAILS.FIRST_PART: Victory Center is the joint work of psychologists, facilitators, coordinators, volunteers, and partner ranches, united by the goal of creating a safe environment for recovery.
TEAM_DETAILS.SECOND_PART: Our team works with servicemen/veterans, children, and their families, undergoes regular training, adheres to the ethical code, values and supports each person.
